decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a rebranded upgrade of the well-received BASIC 518 trommel and has its own page, so it is an established line that is unlikely to be withdrawn.
The flail shredders have a dedicated page and fit Doppstadt's core waste-processing portfolio, so a drop within one year is unlikely.
The mobile grinder is only mentioned on the website, which suggests lower prominence, but machinery lines are rarely withdrawn after one year.
The electric stationary fine shredder is a niche product with only a mention, which raises the risk somewhat, though electrification demand supports keeping it.
Green waste grinding is a core application for the firm, so the product is likely kept despite having only a mention.
The single-shaft pre-shredders have a dedicated page and are a strategic stationary line, so they are likely retained.
